name: mod-2048
description: 2048 above the Claude Code prompt: slide and merge tiles up to 2048. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal with a mouse.
